name: Donkey Kick
steps: Start on hands and knees with your shoulders over wrists and hips over knees.
Brace your core to keep your spine completely neutral throughout the exercise.
Keeping your right knee bent at a 90-degree angle, lift your right leg behind you, pressing the sole of your foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute firmly at the top of the movement, ensuring your lower back does not arch.
Slowly lower the knee back down without touching the floor, completing all reps before switching sides.
coaching_cues: The movement should come purely from the hip joint, not from sagging or arching your lower back.
Keep your neck neutral with your eyes looking down at the mat between your hands.
Push the floor away with your hands to keep your shoulders stable.
